title: cert.rs RevocationChecker injected trait is architecturally correct — no network calls in library
description: RevocationChecker is a caller-injected trait rather than built-in OCSP/CRL support. A contributor might suggest adding a built-in HTTP-based OCSP checker. This should be resisted: (1) the crate is no-network by design invariant; (2) OCSP responder URLs are in the cert, not the crate; (3) async network I/O would violate the no-async invariant; (4) callers with production PKI needs have their own revocation infrastructure. NoRevocationCheck is the right default for offline/air-gapped use cases.
